# Security reports

Report sensitive findings using this repository's private vulnerability reporting
channel when enabled. Do not post credentials, private checkpoints or exploit
details in a public issue.

The repository contact is listed in `configs/release/publication.json`.
Use the public Issues page only to request a private contact route if the
repository's private reporting channel is unavailable.

HF remote-code loading executes model-provided Python. Use the reviewed source
and a fixed model revision; keep private credentials and data outside model
directories. The targeted source scanner complements, but does not replace,
a full credential and license review.
